title: Fourier correlation formula for derandomized acceptance
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\phi:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ be pointwise nonnegative with uniform mean $1$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$. Set $F(x)=(-1)^{f(x)}$, and for $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ write $\widehat F(\gamma)=\mathbb E_x[F(x)(-1)^{\sum_i\gamma_i x_i}]$. Then the derandomized BLR acceptance probability, with $x$ uniform and $y$ distributed according to $\phi$ relative to uniform measure, satisfies
\[2\Pr[f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)]-1=\sum_{\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n}\widehat F(\gamma)^2\,\mathbb E_{y\sim\phi}[F(y)(-1)^{\sum_i\gamma_i y_i}].\]
